# CriticalDataThreshold

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The minimum amount of training data required to trigger the sudden learning transition in quadratic-form models. Knowing this threshold allows TCC systems to pre-allocate communication and computation resources for optimal learning bursts across distributed nodes.
